gold.title: Exported helper exportReportCsv has no caller anywhere in the repo
gold.description: exportReportCsv is added and exported but nothing imports or calls it; the only consumer of this module (summary.ts) uses buildReport alone. Dead weight the typechecker will not flag (unused exports are not errors).

candidate.title: exportReportCsv has no caller anywhere in the repo
candidate.description: Dead export ships as maintained surface area. No package.json or entry point establishes it as public API.

gold.title: Parameter includeTotals is accepted (and passed by the caller) but never read
gold.description: buildReport(rows, includeTotals) never reads includeTotals — the body always computes the total. The caller passes true and gets no behavior for it.

candidate.title: includeTotals parameter is accepted but never read
candidate.description: Parameter advertised in signature but ignored in implementation. Callers passing different values get same result, creating confusion about actual behavior.
